title: Fernwood - the journey Paul described  (414 x A+, 'Midtown condo' as placeholder)
decision: Two doors, two jobs: entry establishes WHO and WHICH PLACE; the vault gates the private tier INSIDE a place.
criteria: Both passwords optional per Paul | crossed once not per visit | the vault never gates the glance | recovery is a person
recommend: F1-F4 as a sequence, with the OPEN QUESTION marked: is F1+F2 met on every open, or once per device? The frames are identical either way; the cost is not.

exhibits.label: 1 · landing page
exhibits.note: Wordmark, the way in, and a human for recovery. No photograph.
exhibits.look: There is exactly ONE photo taken at Fernwood in the whole repo. A stock landscape here would assert a view of the place that is not the place.

exhibits.label: 2 · your places
exhibits.note: The property selection menu. 'Midtown condo' is a placeholder with nothing behind it.
exhibits.look: A whole screen for a binary. Fine as an ENTRY step; expensive if she meets it every open.

exhibits.label: 3 · Fernwood, as it is now
exhibits.note: Unchanged. This is the app today, at 414 x A+.
exhibits.look: Everything above the fold is the glance. Whatever the door costs, it is paid before this.

exhibits.label: 4 · the vault, embedded
exhibits.note: The SECOND door, inside a property: private tier gated in the card stream.
exhibits.look: It sits between Vehicles and Equipment and reads as a native card. The glance is untouched above it.
